$comment: An entry here suppresses a blocking advisory ONLY until its expiry date.
REQUIRED on every entry: ghsa, package, modules, severity, reason, owner, expires.
The schema is fail-closed. A malformed entry fails the scan instead of
silently suppressing nothing; see validateAllowlist() in sca-check.mjs and
An entry stops applying if it expires OR if the advisory's severity changes
from the value reviewed here, which forces a fresh review.
Adding an entry is a maintainer decision and requires PR review.
Do not add an entry when `npm audit fix` or an `overrides` pin can resolve it.

exceptions.reason: Open redirect in react-router 6. The only published fix is react-router-dom 7, a breaking major upgrade in the legacy JavaScript frontend.
exceptions.exposure: client-side is the legacy frontend. No workflow in .github/workflows builds or deploys it; client-side-ts is the deployed frontend and is not affected.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Either migrate client-side to react-router-dom 7, or remove the legacy app from the repository if it is confirmed dead.

exceptions.reason: Constructor injection via SSR hydration in react-router 6. Same breaking-major limitation as GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6, and this application does not use server-side rendering.
exceptions.exposure: client-side is a client-rendered SPA with no SSR hydration path, and no workflow builds or deploys it.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Either migrate client-side to react-router-dom 7, or remove the legacy app from the repository if it is confirmed dead.

exceptions.reason: Braces 3.0.3 is the latest version published to the npm registry, and no patched braces release is available to resolve this advisory.
exceptions.exposure: This is reachable through nodemon/chokidar in the server-side development toolchain and is not a runtime application dependency in production code. It is limited to local development and CI build tooling.
exceptions.required_before_renewal: Replace the dev watcher by changing the server-side dev script to `tsx watch src/index.ts` using the existing tsx dependency, then verify the watch workflow and remove nodemon/chokidar from the dependency tree.
